BiblicalUsage: Rab-Saris was a Babylonian official — a title, 'chief eunuch,' carried as a name. Sennacherib sent the Tartan and Rabsaris and Rabshakeh from Lachish to King Hezekiah at Jerusalem, and after the city fell, Rabsaris sat among the princes of Babylon in the middle gate.
TheologicalSignificance: I am convinced that the names of the invaders are written down because God writes history whole: the men who came against Jerusalem are remembered, and so is the God who delivered her.
RelatedPeople: King Hezekiah; Sennacherib, King of Assyria
